name: plain transfer
description: no message body: a plain TON transfer (or a bare deploy)

name: text comment
description: op 0 = the body is a text comment

name: bounce
description: a bounced message coming back to its sender

name: wallet v5 signed external
description: sign: a user-signed request to a v5 wallet (the usual way a v5 wallet sends)

name: wallet v5 signed internal
description: sint: a signed request delivered to a v5 wallet as an internal message (gasless / relayed)

name: highload v3 internal transfer
description: batch of outgoing actions sent by a highload wallet (exchanges, payout services)

name: jetton transfer
description: owner asks their jetton wallet to send tokens

name: jetton internal transfer
description: jetton wallet to jetton wallet: the tokens moving

name: jetton transfer notification
description: tells the receiver it got tokens; often rejected by receivers that ignore it (MegatonSwap reuses the same op)

name: excesses
description: returns leftover gas TON to the sender

name: NFT transfer
description: owner transfers an NFT

name: NFT ownership assigned
description: tells the new owner it received an NFT; often rejected by receivers that ignore it

name: teleitem start auction
description: starts an auction for a Telegram username or anonymous number

name: teleitem ok
description: acknowledgement from a Telegram username/number item

name: teleitem deploy
description: deploys a Telegram username/number item

name: telemint deploy v2
description: collection mints a new Telegram username/number item

name: teleitem cancel auction
description: cancels an auction for a Telegram username/number

name: auction fill-up
description: tops up a DNS or teleitem contract (also used to extend ownership)

name: STON.fi swap
description: swap request to a STON.fi v2 router

name: STON.fi pay to
description: router pays out swap/liquidity result

name: STON.fi pay vault
description: router sends a referral fee to the vault

name: STON.fi deposit ref fee
description: referral fee deposited into the vault

name: STON.fi payment request
description: pool asks the router to pay out

name: pTON transfer
description: proxy-TON: native TON wrapped to act as a jetton in STON.fi swaps

name: DeDust swap external
description: pool tells the vault/peer about a swap

name: DeDust payout from pool
description: pool asks the vault to pay out the swap result

name: DeDust pay native
description: native TON sent to a DeDust v2 pool to swap

name: DeDust native payout
description: payout callback from a DeDust v2 pool

name: Whales pool update
description: owner updates a Whales staking pool's parameters

name: MarketApp NFT rent
description: signed request to rent an NFT (e.g. a Telegram number)

name: MarketApp NFT rental deploy
description: marker sent when an NFT rental contract is deployed

name: Getgems finish auction
description: settles an NFT auction after its end time
